plainText:
Kohsuke Tanabe (Japanese: 田邊幸輔 Tanabe Kōsuke) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Tanabe was born in Japan and became a voice actor as an adult. Tanabe first worked on Pokémon, voicing minor characters in Pokémon: Hisuian Snow before joining the in . Tanabe gained his most notable role during , voicing Zirc from the Explorers.
